annotations.title: Add, edit or delete an internal note

description: Writes the internal notes on one conversation, named by id, visible to the business’s team. action add writes a note (body, with mentions as a list of usr_ ids of members to notify). action edit changes a note’s body (noteId and body; only its author can). action delete removes a note (noteId; its author, an owner or an admin can). Each delete needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that returns what would happen and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it deletes. add and edit return the note, whose body can quote customers and comes back marked untrusted.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

noteId.description: The noteId in the resource path.
